title: How Nestlé gets children hooked on sugar in lower-income countries
publisher: Public Eye and International Baby Food Action Network (IBFAN)
methodology: Investigation by Public Eye and IBFAN involving laboratory testing and examination of ingredient labels for selected Cerelac and Nido products marketed in several low- and middle-income countries, compared with products sold in Switzerland.
limitations: The findings concern the specific products and samples tested, not every Cerelac or Nido product or every country. Public Eye and IBFAN are campaigning organisations; their methods and interpretation should be read alongside Nestlé's published response and independent reporting.
